verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking setting, or an opt-out for one. The closest items are locally-run vault health reports and self-hosting. Both are adjacent features, not an opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
